images.image_prompt: Ultra-photorealistic live-action photography, vertical 4:5, mobile-thumbnail-readable. A dominant protagonist, an attractive adult Korean Shorthair orange-and-white cheese-tabby cat with a natural, balanced, sturdy build; bright warm cheese-orange short fur with realistic darker orange tabby stripes; large natural upright ears; a broad clean white blaze running from the forehead down between the eyes toward the pink nose; clean white fur around the mouth and muzzle, on the chin, continuing naturally down the entire neck, chest and belly; all four paws and lower feet covered in clean white fur like four neat white boots, with the white fur rising naturally from the toes and clearly visible whenever the paws are shown; a distinctive small congenital orange cheese-tabby fur marking around parts of the mouth area, naturally integrated into the otherwise white muzzle, explicitly a permanent fur pattern and never food, dirt or staining; round amber-brown eyes; pink nose; short dense realistic fur; natural whiskers; slightly rounded cheeks; realistic memorable face. In a Classical sculpture museum overlooking a miniature coastal town square, the pirate cartographer captain catches a falling glowing meteor crystal while hugging a giant wind-whipped blank rescue banner. A luminous geometric portal behind the hero frames the action, marble statues awaken through projection, and tiny buildings make the cat visually colossal. The rescue target is inside the reflection of a physically explained polished display panel; after the catch, the stolen artifact chooses the hero and glows around him. Include Meteor crystal catch, the stolen artifact chooses the hero, the rescue target is inside the reflection, astonished silent gasp, hugging a giant prop, portal behind the hero, one decisive action, safe controlled VFX, no text, no logo, no official symbol, no famous artwork, no franchise design, no cartoon, no illustration, no 3D render, no plastic fur, no duplicate limbs.
